Zero live UI verification. US/UK/Australia untouched. No compliance documents created. Updated by the final local cleanup pass (2026-10-19).
firestore_interaction: NONE. No engine/firebase-admin-init.cjs import, no admin.firestore() call, and no write/read/probe script was executed at any point in this task. All Part 4 re-fetch results below were produced by extractProfileFromHtml()/pickVerifiedName() running against locally-saved HTML files only, and are reported here, not written anywhere.

part1_generalized_validation.summary: Content-safety validation that was previously narrow to the CA-PE Radware bug is now a single shared module, engine/lib/subnational-leader-profile-shared.cjs, used by every fetch path (generic extractor, CA-ON pilot fetcher).
additions: CHALLENGE_PAGE_RE: strong, whole-page-safe markers — radware, cloudflare, captcha, access denied, verifying your browser, checking your browser/connection, 403/404 error page text, request unsuccessful, incident id, ddos protection by, are you a robot, bot protection/detection/management/challenge, security check, attention required, ray id.

JS_REQUIRED_RE: weaker/contextual 'enable JavaScript' markers — deliberately scoped to bio-TEXT-level rejection only (isBioTextSafe), never whole-page rejection, because a real page can legitimately carry this boilerplate alongside real server-rendered content (confirmed directly against ontario.ca's premier page during this fix).

looksLikeNavigationOnly(): rejects text that is overwhelmingly nav/footer/menu fragments (>=4 distinct fragments AND zero sentence punctuation) in English and French (added accueil, rechercher, nous joindre, contactez-nous, plan du site, politique de confidentialité, droits réservés, menu principal after a confirmed quebec.ca false-negative).

hasRepeatedBoilerplateLinkText(): rejects text where a short link-label phrase ('Voir plus', 'En savoir plus', 'Read more', 'Learn more', etc.) repeats 3+ times — catches templated index/hub pages that still have normal sentence punctuation (confirmed necessary against quebec.ca's bilingual premier hub page, which concatenated 6 section teasers each ending 'Voir plus').
isBioTextSafe(text): single bio-text-level gate combining empty/too-short (MIN_BIO_LENGTH=40)/challenge-markers/JS-required/navigation-only/repeated-boilerplate-link checks, returning {safe, reason}.

looksLikeChallengePage(html, stripHtmlFn, firstMatchFn): whole-page gate checking <title> plus a bounded 2000-char body prefix against CHALLENGE_PAGE_RE only (strong tier) — deliberately excludes JS_REQUIRED_RE to avoid rejecting legitimate long pages.

stripHtml() named-entity decoding extended (this task): ’/‘/–/—/“/”/… now decode to real punctuation instead of leaking literal entity text into extracted bio content — found and fixed while validating the recovered CA-BC biography, which otherwise contained literal '’' and '—' strings.
additions2: looksLikeBotChallengePage(html) is now a thin wrapper delegating to the shared looksLikeChallengePage() (kept for backward-compatible naming at call sites).
extractBio() now rejects via the shared isBioTextSafe(bio).safe check instead of inline ad hoc length/regex checks.

caseInsensitiveLiteral(s) helper added: builds a per-character [Xx]-alternation regex fragment so a title word (e.g. 'Premier') can be matched case-insensitively WITHOUT applying the regex /i/ flag to the whole pattern — fixes a confirmed false-positive bug where /i/ combined with [A-Z] name-detection caused 'Premier Danielle Smith is the leader of Alberta's government' to be captured wholesale as a 'name' on a real alberta.ca page.

extractNameCandidates(): the 3 leaderTitle-adjacent regexes had the /i/ flag removed and now build the title-word portion via caseInsensitiveLiteral() instead of escapeRe(), restoring correct case-sensitive name-shape detection.

normalizePersonName(): added stripping of a comma-separated trailing clause ('Doug Ford, Premier of Ontario' -> 'Doug Ford') and a trailing non-abbreviation period ('Christine Fréchette.' -> 'Christine Fréchette').
ROLE_PREFIX_RE extended to include bare 'hon.'/'hon' (not only 'the hon.').

extractContact(): removed a loose no-context 10-digit phone-number fallback regex entirely (confirmed via testing to match non-phone digit runs, e.g. a cache-busting query-string number on quebec.ca and a similarly spurious number on alberta.ca) — kept only the reliable tel: href extraction. Added a sanity check on <address>-tag extraction requiring a digit and rejecting .js/.css/.json/WebComponents/query-string-like content (confirmed necessary: quebec.ca's <address> tag wrapped a script reference, not a real address).
part1_generalized_validation.principle_applied: When a candidate fix risked producing INCORRECT data (inverted name order on a legislature page, generic boilerplate text passed off as a biography), the fix was declined and the specific reason documented rather than forcing a false 'success'. See CA-BC's leg.bc.ca attempt and CA-QC's bio-extraction result below.

part2_ontario_fix.before: fetchCaOn() had `profile.leader_name = 'Doug Ford'` hardcoded as a literal string, never derived from or verified against fetched content, and applied zero content-safety validation to premierHtml/bioHtml/partyHtml before extracting from them.
part2_ontario_fix.after: fetchCaOn() now fetches premierUrl/bioUrl/partyUrl, rejects any of them that looksLikeBotChallengePage() flags, and derives leader_name via pickVerifiedName(premierHtml, 'Premier') || pickVerifiedName(partyHtml, 'Premier') — throwing if neither source yields a verified name, exactly like every other (non-pilot) jurisdiction's generic path. Bio/party/contact extraction now reuse the shared generic extractor functions (extractBio, extractParty, extractContact) instead of Ontario-specific hardcoded regexes.

part3_federal_validation.sanitizeBioText_extended: BOT_CHALLENGE_TEXT_RE in src/utils/mergeProvincialExplorerFirestore.js broadened to match the full engine-side marker set (cloudflare, captcha, access denied, checking browser/connection, javascript-required variants, 403/404 page text, request unsuccessful, ddos protection, bot protection/detection/management/challenge, security check, attention required, ray id — in addition to the pre-existing radware/verifying-your-browser/incident-id markers). MIN_BIO_LENGTH=40 added; sanitizeBioText() now also returns the withheld placeholder for non-empty text shorter than that, not only for contaminated text. Both BIO_WITHHELD_PLACEHOLDER and sanitizeBioText are now exported so src/App.js can reuse them directly instead of duplicating logic.

As Premier of B.C., David is taking action on the biggest challenges facing British Columbians. He's standing up to wealthy speculators and investors to deliver more homes middle-class people can afford. He's working to ease the pressure of everyday costs, from reducing car insurance and childcare bills to making prescription birth control free. And he's strengthening health care by building hospitals and hiring more family doctors. Under David's leadership, B.C. is an economic leader in Canada—creating tens of thousands of good-paying jobs to deliver the lowest unemployment rate and some of the fastest growing wages in the country.

CA-ON.leader_bio: Doug Ford is the Premier of Ontario. He was also elected as the MPP for Etobicoke-North in 2018. Previously, Doug Ford served as Toronto city councillor from 2010-2014, and was vice-chair of the Budget Committee, where he delivered hundreds of millions of dollars in savings for taxpayers. While on city council, Ford served on the board of Build Toronto, and was a director of the Canadian National Exhibition. He also served on the Civic Appointments Committee and the Government Management Committee at Council. A dedicated community leader, successful businessman with Deco Labels and passionate advocate for the people, Doug’s commitment to public service runs in the family. Three generations of Fords have served the people of Ontario in elected office. Doug is a life-long resident of the community of Etobicoke, and lives there with his wife Karla and four daughters.
